extraction.name: Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD)
extraction.description: A new texture dataset of 246,285 images across 56 texture classes, created using text-to-image models and a refinement pipeline to produce high-quality, diverse, and specific texture images.
extraction.creator: Blaine Hoak and Patrick McDaniel
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by generating texture-specific prompts, feeding them into Stable Diffusion model pipelines adapted for texture data, and then filtering the generated images through a three-stage refinement process consisting of frequency analysis, patch variance filtering, and CLIP scoring.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Texture-specific prompts and the resulting generated texture images; the paper also compares against real texture data from the Describable Textures Dataset (DTD).
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The paper notes that models exhibit texture bias, and the dataset is used to measure texture-object associations and uncover learned texture-object biases in object classification models.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Existing texture datasets are limited in size and diversity, often relying on manual collection from public sources, which constrains large-scale analysis and generalization. The paper also notes that safety filters are sensitive to texture data, requiring adaptation of the generation pipeline.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset may support broader AI research by enabling large-scale texture analysis, improving evaluation of model generalization, and helping measure texture bias in object classification models.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for training and evaluation of texture-based tasks, including validating texture quality and representativeness, and measuring texture bias via texture-object association analysis.
